provenance_flux: DYN.6.2 (2026-08-09): feature 'flux' refitted on the 27,638-track CorpusCensusRunner corpus (mean 0.56498, std 0.43400), replacing the 818-track live-annotated training fit (mean 0.25158, std 0.20444). The training fit was NOT stale — it reproduced its own set exactly — but its maximum flux is 1.0167 and 15.3% of the corpus exceeds that, so the model extrapolated on this feature. All other features remain training-fitted. Accepted on the objective corpus A/B in MoodScalerRefitABTests.
